name: Maltitols
aliases: E965, E965i, E965ii, maltitol, maltitol syrup, jarabe de maltitol, maltitoles
what_is: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol obtained by hydrogenation of D-maltose.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E965 because it is a polyol used as a bulk sweetener. WHO/JECFA sets no numerical ADI but notes that excessive consumption of polyols may produce laxative effects. EU rules require a warning above 10% added polyols.
can_1: Detect E965 and map it to sweetener and E-number layers.
can_2: Provide context on glycemic properties and potential digestive discomfort.
cannot_1: Measure the exact percentage of maltitol added.
cannot_2: Confirm if nickel catalyst residues exceed the 2 mg/kg limit.
title: Maltitols
description: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol obtained by hydrogenation of D-maltose.
